training.interpretation: Two finite engineering updates with exact AdamW counters and changed parameter digest; losses are trajectory receipts, not final quality or training efficiency evidence.

identity: Start frozen venv launcher -S suspended, assign job before resume, authenticate worker nonce/PID/creation/Toolhelp ancestry/live job. Before import release, QueryFullProcessImageNameW on retained actual interpreter handle and check explicit frozen base interpreter path/hash plus PID/creation; independently query frozen launcher image. sys.executable self hash remains a launcher claim, not the actual-worker OS image gate. Parent CLI paths are local only; public report retains basename/hash.
native_child: Reuse frozen workload observer launch and identity contract for System32 cmd.exe /d /q /c and literal set /p workload_observer_gate=, anonymous stdin pipe, no inherited job handle, close_fds, shell=False and CREATE_NO_WINDOW. Healthy release writes nonempty done line and checks exit0; retained live worker/native handles checked before healthy finish and busy termination. EOF after worker termination may contribute to child exit; no exclusive kill-cause claim.
stages: Authenticated held self-before/parent/self-after memory brackets at preimport, postimport, postload (model+optimizer object+two fixed batches+initial digest), postupdate (two updates+postvalidation+final digest), then allocated control. Parent waits fixed stage budgets; four primary stages preserve current resident/private and process lifetime peak separately. Postupdate includes validation/digest temporary history, not an isolated backward peak. No new peak/cost benefit claim. Retain exact unchanged load_model start/end/wall inside enclosing prepare interval (asset/train verification, schedule, load, optimizer/batches, initial digest); these descriptive engineering clocks are not comparative model-loading cost science.
process_discovery: Native Toolhelp snapshots at each held stage and pretermination, bounded16level subtree from retained launcher. Known set launcher/actual interpreter/native cmd must be live same-job; unexpected observed descendant fails. Snapshot inventory is not continuous coverage and cannot prove no ephemeral child or validate arbitrary provider behavior. Raw OS thread counts are descriptive; configured Torch1/1 does not prove exact thread ownership.
overhead: Healthy worker remains held at postupdate while parent records fixed0.4s nonsampling then0.4s sampling windows. Preserve raw OS parent CPU start/end and clocks plus sample/query index spans. Sampled window performs actual-worker handle memory/CPU query and Toolhelp snapshot every20ms; record each query and scan wall/process CPU costs, as well as active-stage polling query costs. OS CPU quantization/instrumentation/wake scheduling apply; no claim of causal training slowdown or observer noninterference. All new producer polling and bracket parent memory/CPU samples use the timed wrapper. Costs exclude authentication/image hashing, job/liveness/cleanup, worker-side thread scans, and the parent-CPU queries themselves; neither sum nor window is total observer overhead.
timeout_and_private_threshold: After actual load/two updates, timeout case performs repeated model no_grad forward, at least one completed, no extra backward/optimizer. Sample actual worker for1.5s, max recorded sample gap including boundaries<=0.5s and native CPU progress>=0.25s, verify known subtree live, then terminate whole job. Private threshold uses postupdate private+48MiB, holds touched64MiB, compares parent/self, proves at least one no_grad model forward and sampled crossing, then termination return within1s of allocated self-before. Healthy also holds64MiB with threshold disabled. This is a post-training sampled threshold with overshoot, not a hard import/training/all-descendant cap.
expected_failures: Prehandshake deliberate exit37 has absent handshake and actual interpreter identity unavailable. Import38 occurs only after authenticated preimport bracket/native child, nonce-named missing module exact ModuleNotFoundError, no Torch/Transformers/model/update; actual interpreter and launcher exact38. Other exceptions never satisfy these controls. Cleanup retained handles exited and job0 within4s required for all cases.
freeze_and_execution: Root reviews protocol, exact new source/dependency/Python/base-Python/cmd hashes and pure mocked tests, then writes implementation.json before exactly one acceptance suite in fresh directory. No real model/acceptance preflight, retry, replacement or adaptive threshold change after results. Preserve every case in fixed order and negative result. Each deadline clamps stage/case60s/suite180s; no launch beyond suite deadline; cleanup fits4s and remaining case/suite budget. Three model loads and six dense updates maximum planned. No historical files or results changed.
scientific_boundary: Does not repair historical parent RSS/cap measurements, validate pretrained compression, isolate an actual backward peak, clear failed natural-text joint cost/quality screens, validate external providers/GPU/production, or justify same-setting seed/lr rescue sweeps.
